command: kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-b9e1 -o yaml
kubectl apply -f tiles.yaml -n geo-b9e1 --dry-run=client -o yaml | sed 's/name: tiles/name: tiles-v2/' | kubectl apply -f - -n geo-b9e1
cat tiles.yaml | jq '.metadata.name = "tiles-v2"' | kubectl apply -f - -n geo-b9e1

kubectl get deployment tiles -n geo-b9e1 -o yaml | jq '.metadata.name = "tiles-v2" | del(.metadata.resourceVersion, .metadata.uid, .metadata.creationTimestamp, .metadata.generation, .status, .metadata.annotations)' > tiles-v2.yaml && kubectl apply -f tiles-v2.yaml -n geo-b9e1

kubectl apply -f - -n geo-b9e1 <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tiles-v2
  labels:
    app: tiles
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tiles
      scheme: v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: tiles
        scheme: v2
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: tiles
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - sleep 6; touch /tmp/ready; exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - test
            - -f
            - /tmp/ready
          periodSeconds: 1
          failureThreshold: 1
EOF
kubectl get service tiles -n geo-b9e1 -o yaml
